candidate.rationale: Read the baseline, frozen protocol and all seven complete supplied artifact records. Evaluation 1 used utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0, repair_margin=0 and both RTL actions: cell_area_um2=160081, setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439, hold_slack_ns=0.0945523, zero electrical violations, failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing], physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false. Evaluation 2 changed utilization to 30: cell_area_um2=163224, die_area_um2=495327, setup_slack_ns=0.230194, hold_slack_ns=0.0972317, electrical_violations={max_slew:6,max_cap:1,max_fanout:0}, failure_classes=[electrical], physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false. Both have empty energy_j and estimated_power_w, no postprocessing commands, and no measurement_qualified or score fields; Q is unavailable for both. Passing proposal reviews established admissibility, not measured PPA success. Choose the untried configuration utilization=30, density=0.55, abc_area=0, repair_margin=20 with both RTL actions retained. Change only repair_margin to target the latest observed electrical failure while retaining its positive setup and hold slack. With one evaluation slot left, select the largest allowed repair margin to prioritize electrical qualification; violation counts alone do not reveal severity or establish that either 10 or 20 will suffice. Additional repair can increase buffering, cell area, capacitance and workload energy, consume setup headroom or alter hold timing. No raw critical-path or violating-net evidence establishes a guaranteed repair. Avoid another utilization or density change after the measured timing recovery; retain abc_area=0 to avoid additional mapping timing risk. Both RTL actions are explicitly correctness-qualified: request-gated operand isolation masks multiply inputs unless accepting a request, and exact signed 18-bit reduction is sign extended to 32 bits with unchanged registered cycle contract. They target switching and redundant arithmetic, but isolation adds gates and delay, synthesis may already optimize width, and their independent benefits have not been measured. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(Ew/Ebaseline_w) for DOT64, GEMM8 and CONV3, with baseline energies 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6 and 1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Evaluation 2 cell area is about 0.784% above baseline; even if repair added no area, its geometric-mean energy ratio would need to fall below about 0.99222 for Q<1, and repair area makes that requirement stricter. Larger floorplan and positive timing slack do not establish improvement. Protected evaluation must report configuration, rtl_actions, physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, per-workload energy_j and estimated_power_w, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, physical_manifest, postprocessing_commands, and physical/postprocess/total wall costs. Require frozen correctness, timing, electrical and annotation checks before ranking or comparison with Q thresholds 1.0 and 0.98. Keep period=10526 ps, two threads, Sky130HD TT25C1.8V, clock uncertainty=0.1 ns and IO delay=0.5 ns unchanged. Energy interpretation remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route gate activity and extracted SPEF over reset-deassertion to settled committed completion, without SDF-glitch or silicon-power claims. Retain both failures and costs: evaluation 1 physical/postprocess/total seconds=3156.5922685480327/4.080357030034065e-7/3156.5922689560684; evaluation 2=3487.872255544993/6.690388545393944e-7/3487.872256214032. Two of three new evaluations are captured; this proposal uses only the remaining third slot. The shared aggregate agent budget remains 1200 seconds with EDA wait separate; elapsed_search_seconds=6987.831498471962 includes EDA and supplies no remaining agent-time ledger. Baseline remains the best qualified captured result at Q=1; retain it unless this candidate passes all gates and improves measured Q. This is an unevaluated proposal, with no claimed energy or Q improvement.
